categories.main_business_segments: PSS Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: system sales and parking lot management. The system sales segment includes the development, manufacturing, and sales of automated parking equipment and self-service payment machines under the 'PSS' brand. The parking lot management segment operates parking facilities under the 'CityParking' brand, providing property management, leasing, and professional parking services including public and private parking lots.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AI, cloud computing, big data analytics, and IoT technologies to develop intelligent parking management systems, including AI-driven license plate recognition, cloud-based payment and monitoring platforms, and smart visitor management systems. Production involves in-house assembly and testing of industrial computers, payment modules, cameras, and custom-designed enclosures. The company also integrates ERP systems and develops modular, easy-to-maintain parking equipment with predictive maintenance capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include parking lot owners, commercial complexes, hospitals, government agencies, and urban municipalities. The company serves end markets such as retail shopping centers, medical institutions, urban roadside parking, and smart city projects. It also targets emerging markets for electric vehicle charging and automated payment systems in parking and other self-service domains.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s primary market is Taiwan, with extensive coverage across northern, central, and southern regions. It has begun expanding internationally, notably entering the Thai market with plans to further penetrate Southeast Asia and explore opportunities in Northeast Asia and Western countries such as Japan, South Korea, and Canada.
categories.supply_chain_position: PSS operates vertically integrated across the supply chain, encompassing upstream R&D and manufacturing of parking equipment, midstream system integration and software development, and downstream parking lot operations and management services. This vertical integration enables end-to-end control from product development to service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D focus centers on AI-driven smart parking solutions, including AI-powered membership services, energy-efficient smart roadside ticketing, intelligent building management integrated with parking, and advanced AI license plate recognition. It invests in cloud data analytics, IoT integration, modular equipment design, and AI-enabled maintenance and dispatch systems to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through parking fees collected from consumers, rental income and management fees from parking lot owners, and sales of automated parking and self-service equipment. The company also earns from system installation, maintenance services, and value-added services such as electric vehicle charging and integrated visitor management solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in parking lot management include Park24, Chung Hsing Electric, and Taiwan United, with PSS holding a leading position especially in central and southern Taiwan and in high-value venues like hospitals and shopping malls. In system sales, competitors are mainly domestic mechanical equipment manufacturers with less comprehensive service coverage and R&D investment. PSS distinguishes itself through vertical integration, nationwide service network, and advanced AI and cloud technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$4.72 billion, a 10.39% increase from the previous year, with net profit of NT$458.7 million, reflecting a 16.36% decrease due to external economic factors. Total assets reached NT$9.16 billion with equity of NT$3.46 billion. The company has shown steady growth in parking lot operations with a CAGR of 16.18% over five years and continues to expand its operational footprint and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: PSS emphasizes its vertically integrated business model, combining proprietary AI and cloud technologies with comprehensive system development and nationwide parking management services. Its products offer high customization, advanced AI license plate recognition adaptable to diverse conditions, and seamless integration with smart city initiatives. The company’s dual-brand strategy ('PSS' for systems and 'CityParking' for operations) and strong R&D capabilities provide differentiated value through enhanced operational efficiency, superior customer experience, and innovative smart parking ecosystem solutions.
